$comment: Known alignment schemes. The record schema is framework-agnostic: `scheme` is a free string and this file is the data that names the ones we recognise. `oml validate` warns (does not fail) on a scheme that is not listed here or a URI that does not match the listed pattern. Adding a framework is a change to this file, not to the schema.

schemes.name: CASE
schemes.description: 1EdTech CASE item identifiers (CASE Network or any CASE server).

schemes.name: OML
schemes.description: OML concept URIs, <base>/c/<concept-id>, used only where no CASE URI exists.

schemes.name: CCSS
schemes.description: Common Core State Standards canonical URLs on corestandards.org.

schemes.name: progmiscon
schemes.description: Programming misconception inventory entries (Chiodini et al., ITiCSE 2021).
